Dr.M.Kavikkumar vs State Of Tamil Nadu on 26 April, 2024 
Author: D.Bharatha Chakravarthy
Bench: D.Bharatha Chakravarthy
 
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras
 Dated : 26.04.2024
 Coram :
 The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice D.Bharatha Chakravarthy
 W.P.No.12015 of 2024
 and W.M.P.No.13103 of 2024
 1. Dr.M.Kavikkumar
 2. Dr.A.Pushparaj
 3. Dr.S.Mariyappan .. Petitio 
 Versus  1. State of Tamil Nadu,
 Represented by its Principal Secretary to the Government,
 Health and Family Welfare Department,
 Secretariat,
 Chennai - 9.
 2. The Commissioner,
 Food Safety and Drug Administration Department,
 DMS Complex,
 Anna Salai, 
 Teynampet, 
 Chennai - 6. .. Respondents  Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o  pleased to issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the respondent No.2 he  to consider the request for Transfer made by the petitioners by thei  applications, dated 13.07.2022, 11.07.2022, 20.06.2022 respectively   light of the letter issued by the respondent https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  1/5  W.P  R.No.5594/2022/S1/FSD, dated 15.06.2022 and G.O.Ms.No.10, dated Dr.M.Kavikkumar vs State Of Tamil Nadu on 26 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76641319/
1  07.01.1994, issued by the Administrative Reforms Department.
 For Petitioners : Mr.K.Thilageswaran  For Respondents : Mr.Bindhran,
 Additional Government Pleader  ORDER This Writ Petition is filed for a direction to the second respondent to consider the request for transfer made by the petitioners by their applications in the light of the letter issued by the second respondent, dated 15.06.2022 and G.O.Ms.No.10, dated 07.01.1994.
2. The case of the petitioners is that all three petitioners have made applications for request transfer on 13.07.2022, 11.07.2022 and 20.06.2022 respectively as per the transfer guidelines. The same have not been considered and hence this Writ Petition.
3. Transfer and place of posting are the incidents of service and it is for the respondents to consider the request transfer as per the policy. The learned Additional Government Pleader for the respondents submits that the request transfer, if any, will be considered as per the request transfer https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis seniority as and when the exercise of considering the general transfer is taken up in the department.
4. Accordingly, this Writ Petition is disposed of with a direction to the respondents to consider the applications of the petitioners for request transfer in the manner known to law and in accordance with their transfer policy as and when the issue of considering the request transfer is taken up. 
There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
